title: Reuse the scan snapshot while file/dir stats are unchanged
weakness: Even with string paths, every query repeats the full directory walk; the corpus is unchanged across the five benchmark batches.
hypothesis: Validating cached directory mtimes and file mtime/size, then reusing the parsed snapshot, should cut warm latency by at least 20% over E002 with no stale results.
risk: Incorrect cache invalidation could return stale results; guarded by full-walk fallback on any stat mismatch and frozen correctness hashes.
